public.text: The layered regional-governance model appropriately separates regional and national authority but does not address conformance assessment, trust-list management, certificate governance, cross-border terminology services, or incident coordination.
public.suggestedRevision: Add these shared operational governance areas and define the handoff between regional and national authorities for conformance, trust, security incidents, terminology, identity, consent, and service continuity.
